arxiv-2204-03999.title: On the derivations of the Equation of Hydrostatic Equilibrium
arxiv-2204-03999.creator: Kṛṣṇa Dev
arxiv-2204-03999.description:
A 2022 arXiv research paper by Kṛṣṇa Dev. Abstract

We develop and present a geometrical and an analytical derivation of the equation of hydrostatic equilibrium in spherically symmetric stars with a generalized stress tensor. The analytical derivation is based on the Navier-Cauchy equation. We also critically examine the derivation of this equation found in textbooks on stellar astrophysics and show that there are errors in many of the derivations presented in textbooks.

arxiv-2206-08798.title: Open Source Variational Quantum Eigensolver Extension of the Quantum Learning Machine (QLM) for Quantum Chemistry Publication type: RESEARCH ARTICLE
arxiv-2206-08798.creator: Mohammad Haidar*, Marko J. Rančić, Thomas Ayral, Yvon Maday, Jean-Philip Piquemal*, M. Haidar, M. J. Rančić, T. Ayral, Y. Maday, J-P. Piquemal
arxiv-2206-08798.description: Abstract Quantum Chemistry (QC) is one of the most promising applications of Quantum Computing. However, present quantum processing units (QPUs) are still subject to large errors. Therefore, noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) hardware is limited in terms of qubit counts/circuit depths. Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) algorithms can potentially overcome such issues. Here, we introduce the OpenVQE open-source QC package.

arxiv-2308-07284.title: Cross-Attribute Matrix Factorization Model with Shared User Embedding
arxiv-2308-07284.creator: Wen Liang, Zeng Fan, Youzhi Liang, Jianguo Jia
arxiv-2308-07284.description: Abstract Over the past few years, deep learning has firmly established its prowess across various domains, including computer vision, speech recognition, and natural language processing. Motivated by its outstanding success, researchers have been directing their efforts towards applying deep learning techniques to recommender systems.

arxiv-2402-16566.title: Quick unsupervised hyperspectral dimensionality reduction for earth observation: a comparison
arxiv-2402-16566.creator: Daniela Lupu, Joseph L. Garrett, Tor Arne Johansen, Milica Orlandic, Ion Necoara
arxiv-2402-16566.description: Abstract Dimensionality reduction can be applied to hyperspectral images so that the most useful data can be extracted and processed more quickly. This is critical in any situation in which data volume exceeds the capacity of the computational resources, particularly in the case of remote sensing platforms (e.g., drones, satellites), but also in the case of multi-year datasets.

arxiv-2407-15856.title: An approach to Borwein integrals from the point of view of residue theory
arxiv-2407-15856.creator: Daniel Cao Labora 1, Gonzalo Cao Labora 2
arxiv-2407-15856.description: Abstract . Borwein integrals are one of the most popularly known phenomena in contemporary mathematics. They were found in 2001 by David Borwein and Jonathan Borwein and consist of a simple family of integrals involving the cardinal sine function “sinc”, so that the first integrals are equal to π \pi until, suddenly, that pattern breaks.

arxiv-2505-21984.title: Stress distribution in elastic disks with a hole under uniaxial compression
arxiv-2505-21984.creator: \firstname Ken \lastname Okamura \fnsep, \firstname Yosuke \lastname Sato, \firstname Satoshi \lastname Takada \fnsep
arxiv-2505-21984.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by \firstname Ken \lastname Okamura \fnsep, \firstname Yosuke \lastname Sato, \firstname Satoshi \lastname Takada \fnsep. This paper investigates the stress and displacement distribution in a two-dimensional elastic hollow disk subjected to distributed diametric loading, extending our previous analysis of concentrated loading [Okamura et al. 57 , 102–114 (2025)]. The study provides deeper insights into the mechanical behavior of materials such as concrete and rock by examining the effects of load distribution on stress localization and displacement patterns.

europmc-pmc3061868.creator: Nanthakumar N, Meng D, Goldstein AM, Zhu W, Lu L, Uauy R, Llanos A, Claud EC, Walker WA.

The pathogenesis of NEC is associated with an excessive inflammatory IL-8 response. In this study, we

pmc-10670665.title: Estrogen-Receptor-Low-Positive Breast Cancer: Pathological and Clinical Perspectives
pmc-10670665.creator: Christina Panagiotis Malainou, Nikolina Stachika, Aikaterini Konstantina Damianou, Aristotelis Anastopoulos, Ioanna Ploumaki, Efthymios Triantafyllou, Konstantinos Drougkas, Georgia Gomatou, Elias Kotteas
pmc-10670665.description: The expression of estrogen receptors (ERs) in breast cancer (BC) represents a strong prognostic and predictive biomarker and directs therapeutic decisions in early and advanced stages. ER-low-positive BC, defined by the immunohistochemical (IHC) expression of ERs from 1% to 9%, constitutes a distinct subset of total BC cases.

pmc-10674728.title: Anisakid Presence in the European Conger, Conger conger, from Spanish Mediterranean Waters †
pmc-10674728.creator: Xavier Roca-Geronès, Lídia Sarrà-Alarcón, Eulàlia Delgado, Maria Magdalena Alcover, Margarida Casadevall, Roser Fisa, Francisco Javier Adroher, Rocío Benítez-Rodríguez, Manuel Morales-Yuste
pmc-10674728.description: The European conger, Conger conger, is a benthic marine fish species with a geographical distribution extending through the northeastern Atlantic and the Mediterranean. Despite being extensively distributed and widely appreciated by Spanish consumers, studies regarding parasite presence in this fish are scarce.

pmc-10681755.title: Radiological Vascular Anatomy of the Caudate Lobe of the Liver Required for Transarterial Chemoembolization of Hepatocellular Carcinoma
pmc-10681755.creator: Shiro Miyayama
pmc-10681755.description: The caudate lobe is located between the bilateral hepatic lobes and is divided into three subsegments: the Spiegel lobe, paracaval portion, and caudate process. The caudate artery arises from various sites of the bilateral hepatic arteries as an independent branch, common trunk, or arcade. Extrahepatic arteries can enter the caudate lobe mainly by the right inferior phrenic artery.

pmc-10742018.title: Self-Reported Baseline Quality of Life Mirrors Treatment-Specific Characteristics of Cancer Patients
pmc-10742018.creator: Anja Thronicke, Shiao Li Oei, Gerrit Grieb, Patricia Grabowski, Juliane Roos, Friedemann Schad, Rachel Taylor, Avraham Eisbruch
pmc-10742018.description: Simple SummaryContradictory research exists on the association of self-reported quality of life at tumor diagnosis (baseline quality of life, bQL) with treatment and disease-specific characteristics in oncological patients. The aim of our prospective study was to examine the role of bQL as a treatment predictor in oncological patients.

pmc-11321092.title: Accuracy of the surgical execution of virtually planned deep circumflex iliac artery flaps and their appropriateness for masticatory rehabilitation
pmc-11321092.creator: Florian Peters, Stefan Raith, Anna Bock, Kristian Kniha, Mark Ooms, Stephan Christian Möhlhenrich, Frank Hölzle, Ali Modabber
pmc-11321092.description: BackgroundTumorous diseases of the jaw demand effective treatments, often involving continuity resection of the jaw. Reconstruction via microvascular bone flaps, like deep circumflex iliac artery flaps (DCIA), is standard. Computer aided planning (CAD) enhances accuracy in reconstruction using patient-specific CT images to create three-dimensional (3D) models. Data on the accuracy of CAD-planned DCIA flaps is scarce.

pmc-11434055.title: Towards Nickel–NHC Fluoro Complexes—Synthesis of Imidazolium Fluorides and Their Reactions with Nickelocene
pmc-11434055.creator: Siobhan S Wills, Corinne Bailly, Michael J Chetcuti, Juan Niclós-Gutiérrez, Miquel Barceló-Oliver, Uwe Monkowius
pmc-11434055.description: While hundreds of complexes of the general formula [Ni(η5-C5H5)(NHC)(X)] exist (NHC = a N-heterocyclic carbene, X = Cl, Br, I), none is yet known with X = F. We attempted to prepare such a species by reacting nickelocene with imidazolium fluorides.

pmc-11483251.title: Retention in HIV Primary Care Using a Web-Based Patient Engagement Platform: Multistate Case-Control Study
pmc-11483251.creator: Adam Carl Sukhija-Cohen, Henna Patani, Michael Foxworth Blasingame, Kathy Linh Vu, Ramin Bastani, Amaryllis Mavragani, Hailey J Gilmore, Marie Stoner
pmc-11483251.description: BackgroundDigital interventions to improve retention in HIV care are critical to ensure viral suppression and prevent further transmission. AIDS Healthcare Foundation Healthcare Centers are centers across the United States that provide primary HIV care. Traditionally, the Healthcare Centers conduct phone calls with patients to schedule and confirm appointments, as well as share laboratory results.

pmc-11672536.title: Spectroscopic Signatures of Phonon Character in Molecular Electron Spin Relaxation
pmc-11672536.creator: Nathanael
pmc-11672536.description: Spin–lattice relaxation constitutes a key challenge for the development of quantum technologies, as it destroys superpositions in molecular quantum bits (qubits) and magnetic memory in single molecule magnets (SMMs). Gaining mechanistic insight into the spin relaxation process has proven challenging owing to a lack of spectroscopic observables and contradictions among theoretical models.

pmc-12598673.title: Dysregulation of Glial Gap Junction Protein Innexin2 Mediates Seizures and Disrupted Sleep in a Drosophila Model for North Sea Progressive Myoclonus Epilepsy
pmc-12598673.creator: Nicola A. Grzeschik, Roald A. Lambrechts, Marianne van der Zwaag, Ellie Eggens‐Meijer, Ody C. M. Sibon, Jenke A. Gorter
pmc-12598673.description: North Sea Progressive Myoclonus Epilepsy (NS‐PME) is a rare genetic disease that presents at an early age with progressive ataxia, myoclonus, and epilepsy. The disease is caused by a mutation in the Golgi SNAP receptor 2 gene (GOSR2). However, the consequences of this genetic defect at the cellular level are still unknown.

pmc-12636005.title: Nitrite Reduction at Low Overpotentials on N‑Doped Carbon: When Metal Single Atoms Become Poisons
pmc-12636005.creator: Yizhou Dai, Xinyue Zheng, Markus Antonietti, Mateusz Odziomek
pmc-12636005.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). We report a nitrogen-doped carbon derived from tetracyanoquinodimethane (TCNQ900) that alone catalyzes nitrite reduction (NO2 – RR) to NH3 with an onset potential higher than +0.10 V vs RHE and catalytic activity rivaling state-of-the-art transition-metal catalysts.

pmc-13287853.title: 14: TEAD Inhibition by IAG933 as a Novel Therapeutic Strategy for Cholangiocarcinoma
pmc-13287853.creator: Hidemi Nishi, Erik Jessen, Brandon A Wilbanks, Danielle M Carlson, Amro M Abdelrahman, Enis H Ozmert, J Pedro F Safi, Shelby K Yee, Emily L Siegler, Jack W Sample, Nathan W Werneburg, Rory L Smoot
pmc-13287853.description: BackgroundCholangiocarcinoma (CCA) is an aggressive hepatobiliary malignancy with marked molecular heterogeneity, limited systemic treatment options, and poor prognosis. Chemoresistance and KRAS mutations remain major therapeutic challenges. Dysregulation of the Hippo pathway, particularly YAP/TAZ hyperactivation, drives CCA progression and resistance. TEAD, the essential transcriptional partner of YAP/TAZ, represents a promising target.

pmc-13422685.title: Association between research exposure and medical specialization choices among medical students and trainees in Saudi Arabia: A cross sectional study
pmc-13422685.creator: Nasser E. Alotaibi, Mariam M. Albjadi, Naif S. Almuhaydili, Saja A. Alharbi, Shahad N. Alasmary, Abdulaziz A. Alhumam, Arwa M. Alahmari, Shouq S. Al-Awashz, Ibrahim H. Tawhari
pmc-13422685.description: BACKGROUND:Research exposure may shape specialty choice, but how its timing, duration, and perceived importance connect to career decisions is not well understood, particularly in Saudi Arabia. This study examined that link between medical students, interns, and junior residents in Saudi Arabia and the perceived high research impact on career decisions and identified factors affecting their prediction.
